injections.name: clean control
injections.implementation: no injection; substream-separated stateful RNG both arms

injections.name: seed namespace conversion (16-bit truncation)
injections.implementation: arm B effective seed = declared & 0xFFFF (16-bit truncation); seeds drawn from [2^20,2^40) so truncation always bites; arm B only

injections.name: stateful draw shift (one extra burn draw in arm B)
injections.implementation: arm B consumes one extra dealer-stream draw before EVERY hand (recurring shift; robust to RandomState refill realignment)

injections.name: event-keyed repair
injections.implementation: both arms use SHA-256 counter-based event-keyed draws keyed by (stream, event_id); deck order and actions are pure functions of keys
injections.validates: Branch E repair construction; alignment exact by construction

injections.name: clock-bounded computation (wall-clock think budget)
injections.implementation: random-policy agent spends a wall-clock think budget per step; budget scales with process rank (0.30ms * (1 + 0.75*(rank%3))) so trajectories vary across execution contexts; think draws on isolated agent stream
injections.detects: cross-context replay digest mismatch; coupled-stream fingerprints remain equal (scoped instability)

injections.name: process-global mutable state (worker reuse)
injections.implementation: module-level cache contamination: reused-worker context burns one dealer draw before hand 0 AND forces first action of hand 0 to last legal id
injections.detects: context testing: reused-context dealer fingerprint differs from fresh-context

injections.name: queue/enqueue order dependence
injections.implementation: queue-order skew: deterministic per-arm draw tax every hand (arm A: rank%3; arm B: (7*rank+1)%3), emulating enqueue-order-dependent worker behavior
injections.detects: direct cross-arm desync on many rows + context reorder fingerprint shifts

injections.name: missing/dropped schedule rows before analysis
injections.implementation: harness drops every 3rd schedule row after acquisition, before analysis (row index % 3 == 2)

injections.name: benign residual randomness, valid repeated-measures design
injections.implementation: S4-style clock jitter PLUS repeats_per_seed=3 AND repeated-measures/hierarchical analysis declaration
injections.validates: false-suppression trap: replay impossible but paired inference remains valid

injections.name: pseudoreplication (decisions treated as independent replicates)
injections.implementation: analysis declares decision-level unit (pseudoreplication) instead of seed-condition cluster

injections.name: valid unpaired design (independent seeds, declared)
injections.implementation: arms use independent seeds (B = A + 1,000,003), independence declared in schedule
injections.validates: unpaired-design validity; paired wording must be suppressed

ground_truth_principle: All labels follow from construction at the harness level, not from observed outcomes. Label semantics: VALID=claim admissible as worded; DOWNGRADE=only weaker wording supported; INVALID=no admissible version; NOT_APPLICABLE=no such claim asserted under this scenario.
